kernel_type:
∀ {p : GoLean.GoCore.Program} {world : GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.World} {s : GoLean.GoCore.ExecState}
  {fid : GoLean.GoCore.FuncId} {f : GoLean.GoCore.Func} {args : List GoLean.GoValue}
  {Γ : GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryTyping.Context} {env : GoLean.GoCore.LocalEnv}
  {plans : List (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.TargetShape × List GoLean.GoCore.Expr)} {k : GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont},
  GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryTyping.ProgramTyped p →
    GoLean.GoCore.BooleanRuntime.SameContext (GoLean.GoCore.BooleanRuntime.programState p) s →
      GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.HeapTyped world s →
        GoLean.GoCore.findFunctionIn? p.funcs fid = some f →
          GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.ParamsValues world f.args.toList args →
            GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.EnvTyped world Γ env →
              GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.PlansTyped Γ plans f.results.toList →
                GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.ReturnCont world p.funcs k →
                  ∀ (ch : GoLean.GoCore.Choices),
                    ∃ next env' roots t,
                      GoLean.GoCore.Machine.enterFramePick s fid args ch =
                          Except.ok (GoLean.Result.ok (f, env', roots, t), ch) ∧
                        GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.StoreExtension world next s t ∧
                          f.wrapper = false ∧
                            GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.Control next p.funcs
                              (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Config.exec f.body env'
                                (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont.frame plans env roots [] k))

kernel_type:
∀ {p : GoLean.GoCore.Program} {world : GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.World} {s : GoLean.GoCore.ExecState}
  {callee : GoLean.GoValue} {args : List GoLean.GoValue} {k : GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont},
  GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryTyping.ProgramTyped p →
    GoLean.GoCore.BooleanRuntime.SameContext (GoLean.GoCore.BooleanRuntime.programState p) s →
      GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.HeapTyped world s →
        GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.PendingCall world p.funcs callee args →
          GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.ExitCont world p.funcs k →
            ∀ (ch : GoLean.GoCore.Choices),
              ∃ fid caps f next env roots t,
                callee = GoLean.GoValue.funcVal fid caps ∧
                  GoLean.GoCore.Machine.enterFramePick s fid (caps ++ args) ch =
                      Except.ok (GoLean.Result.ok (f, env, roots, t), ch) ∧
                    GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.StoreExtension world next s t ∧
                      f.wrapper = false ∧
                        GoLean.GoCore.RecoveryRuntime.Control next p.funcs
                          (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Config.exec f.body env
                            (GoLean.GoCore.Machine.Cont.frame [] [] [] [] k))
